verses.original: Μιμηταί μου γίνεσθε καθὼς κἀγὼ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Mimētai mou ginesthe kathōs kagō Christou
verses.literal: You are to imitate me just as I imitate Christ

verses.original: Ἐπαινῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς ὅτι πάντα μου μέμνησθε καὶ καθὼς παρέδωκα ὑμῖν τὰς παραδόσεις κατέχετε
verses.transliteration: Epainō de hymas hoti panta mou memnēsthe kai kathōs paredōka hymin tas paradoseis katechete
verses.literal: Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions just as I passed them on to you

verses.original: Θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ὅτι παντὸς ἀνδρὸς ἡ κεφαλὴ ὁ Χριστός ἐστιν κεφαλὴ δὲ γυναικὸς ὁ ἀνήρ κεφαλὴ δὲ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: Thelō de hymas eidenai hoti pantos andros hē kephalē ho Christos estin kephalē de gynaikos ho anēr kephalē de tou Christou ho Theos
verses.literal: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ and the head of the woman is man and the head of Christ is God

verses.original: Πᾶς ἀνὴρ προσευχόμενος ἢ προφητεύων κατὰ κεφαλῆς ἔχων καταισχύνει τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Pas anēr proseuchomenos ē prophēteuōn kata kephalēs echōn kataischynei tēn kephalēn autou
verses.literal: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head

verses.original: πᾶσα δὲ γυνὴ προσευχομένη ἢ προφητεύουσα ἀκατακαλύπτῳ τῇ κεφαλῇ καταισχύνει τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῆς ἓν γάρ ἐστιν καὶ τὸ αὐτὸ τῇ ἐξυρημένῃ
verses.transliteration: pasa de gynē proseuchomenē ē prophēteuousa akatakalyptō tē kephalē kataischynei tēn kephalēn autēs hen gar estin kai to auto tē exyrēmenē
verses.literal: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head for it is just as if her head were shaved

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ οὐ κατακαλύπτεται γυνή καὶ κειράσθω εἰ δὲ αἰσχρὸν γυναικὶ τὸ κείρασθαι ἢ ξυρᾶσθαι κατακαλυπτέσθω
verses.transliteration: ei gar ou katakalyptetai gynē kai keirasthō ei de aischron gynaiki to keirasthai ē xyrasthai katakalyptesthō
verses.literal: If a woman does not cover her head she should have her hair cut off And if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off she should cover her head

verses.original: Ἀνὴρ μὲν γὰρ οὐκ ὀφείλει κατακαλύπτεσθαι τὴν κεφαλήν εἰκὼν καὶ δόξα Θεοῦ ὑπάρχων ἡ γυνὴ δὲ δόξα ἀνδρός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Anēr men gar ouk opheilei katakalyptesthai tēn kephalēn eikōn kai doxa Theou hyparchōn hē gynē de doxa andros estin
verses.literal: A man ought not to cover his head since he is the image and glory of God but the woman is the glory of man

verses.original: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν ἀνὴρ ἐκ γυναικός ἀλλὰ γυνὴ ἐξ ἀνδρός
verses.transliteration: ou gar estin anēr ek gynaikos alla gynē ex andros
verses.literal: For man did not come . . . from woman but woman from man

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ οὐκ ἐκτίσθη ἀνὴρ διὰ τὴν γυναῖκα ἀλλὰ γυνὴ διὰ τὸν ἄνδρα
verses.transliteration: kai gar ouk ektisthē anēr dia tēn gynaika alla gynē dia ton andra
verses.literal: Neither . . . . . . was man created for woman but woman for man

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο ὀφείλει ἡ γυνὴ ἐξουσίαν ἔχειν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς διὰ τοὺς ἀγγέλους
verses.transliteration: dia touto opheilei hē gynē exousian echein epi tēs kephalēs dia tous angelous
verses.literal: For this reason . . . a woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head because of the angels

verses.original: Πλὴν οὔτε γυνὴ χωρὶς ἀνδρὸς οὔτε ἀνὴρ χωρὶς γυναικὸς ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Plēn oute gynē chōris andros oute anēr chōris gynaikos en Kyriō
verses.literal: In the Lord however woman is not independent of man nor is man independent of woman

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἡ γυνὴ ἐκ τοῦ ἀνδρός οὕτως καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ διὰ τῆς γυναικός τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hōsper gar hē gynē ek tou andros houtōs kai ho anēr dia tēs gynaikos ta de panta ek tou Theou
verses.literal: For just as woman came from man so also man is born of woman But everything comes from God

verses.original: Ἐν ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς κρίνατε πρέπον ἐστὶν γυναῖκα ἀκατακάλυπτον τῷ Θεῷ προσεύχεσθαι
verses.transliteration: En hymin autois krinate prepon estin gynaika akatakalypton tō Theō proseuchesthai
verses.literal: Judge for yourselves Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered

verses.original: οὐδὲ ἡ φύσις αὐτὴ διδάσκει ὑμᾶς ὅτι ἀνὴρ μὲν ἐὰν κομᾷ ἀτιμία αὐτῷ ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: oude hē physis autē didaskei hymas hoti anēr men ean koma atimia autō estin
verses.literal: Doesn’t nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair it is a disgrace to him

verses.original: γυνὴ δὲ ἐὰν κομᾷ δόξα αὐτῇ ἐστιν ὅτι ἡ κόμη ἀντὶ περιβολαίου δέδοται αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: gynē de ean koma doxa autē estin hoti hē komē anti peribolaiou dedotai autē
verses.literal: but that if a woman has long hair it is her glory For long hair is given to her as a covering

verses.original: Εἰ δέ τις δοκεῖ φιλόνεικος εἶναι ἡμεῖς τοιαύτην συνήθειαν οὐκ ἔχομεν οὐδὲ αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ei de tis dokei philoneikos einai hēmeis toiautēn synētheian ouk echomen oude hai ekklēsiai tou Theou
verses.literal: If anyone is inclined to dispute this . . . . . . we have no other practice nor do the churches of God

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ παραγγέλλων οὐκ ἐπαινῶ ὅτι οὐκ εἰς τὸ κρεῖσσον ἀλλὰ εἰς τὸ ἧσσον συνέρχεσθε
verses.transliteration: Touto de parangellōn ouk epainō hoti ouk eis to kreisson alla eis to hēsson synerchesthe
verses.literal: In the following instructions I have no praise to offer because your gatherings do more harm than good

verses.original: πρῶτον μὲν γὰρ συνερχομένων ὑμῶν ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ ἀκούω σχίσματα ἐν ὑμῖν ὑπάρχειν καὶ μέρος τι πιστεύω
verses.transliteration: prōton men gar synerchomenōn hymōn en ekklēsia akouō schismata en hymin hyparchein kai meros ti pisteuō
verses.literal: First of all I hear that when you come together as a church there are divisions among you and in part I believe it

verses.original: δεῖ γὰρ καὶ αἱρέσεις ἐν ὑμῖν εἶναι ἵνα καὶ οἱ δόκιμοι φανεροὶ γένωνται ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: dei gar kai haireseis en hymin einai hina kai hoi dokimoi phaneroi genōntai en hymin
verses.literal: And indeed there must be differences among you to show which of you are approved

verses.original: Συνερχομένων οὖν ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ οὐκ ἔστιν κυριακὸν δεῖπνον φαγεῖν
verses.transliteration: Synerchomenōn oun hymōn epi to auto ouk estin kyriakon deipnon phagein
verses.literal: Now then when you come together . . . . . . . . . it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat

verses.original: ἕκαστος γὰρ τὸ ἴδιον δεῖπνον προλαμβάνει ἐν τῷ φαγεῖν καὶ ὃς μὲν πεινᾷ ὃς δὲ μεθύει
verses.transliteration: hekastos gar to idion deipnon prolambanei en tō phagein kai hos men peina hos de methyei
verses.literal: For as you eat each of you goes ahead without sharing his meal While one remains hungry another gets drunk

verses.original: μὴ γὰρ οἰκίας οὐκ ἔχετε εἰς τὸ ἐσθίειν καὶ πίνειν ἢ τῆς ἐκκλησίας τοῦ Θεοῦ καταφρονεῖτε καὶ καταισχύνετε τοὺς μὴ ἔχοντας τί εἴπω ὑμῖν ἐπαινέσω ὑμᾶς ἐν τούτῳ οὐκ ἐπαινῶ
verses.transliteration: mē gar oikias ouk echete eis to esthiein kai pinein ē tēs ekklēsias tou Theou kataphroneite kai kataischynete tous mē echontas ti eipō hymin epainesō hymas en toutō ouk epainō
verses.literal: Don’t . . . you have your own homes in which to eat and drink Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing What can I say to you Shall I praise you for this No I will not

verses.original: Ἐγὼ γὰρ παρέλαβον ἀπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου ὃ καὶ παρέδωκα ὑμῖν ὅτι ὁ Κύριος Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ᾗ παρεδίδετο ἔλαβεν ἄρτον
verses.transliteration: Egō gar parelabon apo tou Kyriou ho kai paredōka hymin hoti ho Kyrios Iēsous en tē nykti hē paredideto elaben arton
verses.literal: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you The Lord Jesus on the night He was betrayed took bread

verses.original: καὶ εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ εἶπεν Τοῦτό μού ἐστιν τὸ σῶμα τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν τοῦτο ποιεῖτε εἰς τὴν ἐμὴν ἀνάμνησιν
verses.transliteration: kai eucharistēsas eklasen kai eipen Touto mou estin to sōma to hyper hymōn touto poieite eis tēn emēn anamnēsin
verses.literal: and when He had given thanks He broke it and said This is My body which is for you do this in remembrance of Me

verses.original: ὡσαύτως καὶ τὸ ποτήριον μετὰ τὸ δειπνῆσαι λέγων Τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἡ καινὴ διαθήκη ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ ἐμῷ αἵματι τοῦτο ποιεῖτε ὁσάκις ἐὰν πίνητε εἰς τὴν ἐμὴν ἀνάμνησιν
verses.transliteration: hōsautōs kai to potērion meta to deipnēsai legōn Touto to potērion hē kainē diathēkē estin en tō emō haimati touto poieite hosakis ean pinēte eis tēn emēn anamnēsin
verses.literal: In the same way . . . after supper He took the cup saying This cup is the new covenant in My blood do this as often as you drink it in remembrance of Me

verses.original: ὁσάκις γὰρ ἐὰν ἐσθίητε τὸν ἄρτον τοῦτον καὶ τὸ ποτήριον πίνητε τὸν θάνατον τοῦ Κυρίου καταγγέλλετε ἄχρι οὗ ἔλθῃ
verses.transliteration: hosakis gar ean esthiēte ton arton touton kai to potērion pinēte ton thanaton tou Kyriou katangellete achri hou elthē
verses.literal: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup you proclaim the Lord’s death until . . . He comes

verses.original: Ὥστε ὃς ἂν ἐσθίῃ τὸν ἄρτον ἢ πίνῃ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦ Κυρίου ἀναξίως ἔνοχος ἔσται τοῦ σώματος καὶ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Hōste hos an esthiē ton arton ē pinē to potērion tou Kyriou anaxiōs enochos estai tou sōmatos kai tou haimatos tou Kyriou
verses.literal: Therefore whoever . . . eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord

verses.original: δοκιμαζέτω δὲ ἄνθρωπος ἑαυτόν καὶ οὕτως ἐκ τοῦ ἄρτου ἐσθιέτω καὶ ἐκ τοῦ ποτηρίου πινέτω
verses.transliteration: dokimazetō de anthrōpos heauton kai houtōs ek tou artou esthietō kai ek tou potēriou pinetō
verses.literal: Each one must examine himself before . . . he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ ἐσθίων καὶ πίνων κρίμα ἑαυτῷ ἐσθίει καὶ πίνει μὴ διακρίνων τὸ σῶμα
verses.transliteration: ho gar esthiōn kai pinōn krima heautō esthiei kai pinei mē diakrinōn to sōma
verses.literal: For anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body eats and drinks judgment on himself

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο ἐν ὑμῖν πολλοὶ ἀσθενεῖς καὶ ἄρρωστοι καὶ κοιμῶνται ἱκανοί
verses.transliteration: dia touto en hymin polloi astheneis kai arrōstoi kai koimōntai hikanoi
verses.literal: That is why . . . many among you are weak and sick and a number of you have fallen asleep

verses.original: Εἰ δὲ ἑαυτοὺς διεκρίνομεν οὐκ ἂν ἐκρινόμεθα
verses.transliteration: Ei de heautous diekrinomen ouk an ekrinometha
verses.literal: Now if we judged ourselves properly we would not come under judgment

verses.original: κρινόμενοι δὲ ὑπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου παιδευόμεθα ἵνα μὴ σὺν τῷ κόσμῳ κατακριθῶμεν
verses.transliteration: krinomenoi de hypo tou Kyriou paideuometha hina mē syn tō kosmō katakrithōmen
verses.literal: But when we are judged by the Lord we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world

verses.original: Ὥστε ἀδελφοί μου συνερχόμενοι εἰς τὸ φαγεῖν ἀλλήλους ἐκδέχεσθε
verses.transliteration: Hōste adelphoi mou synerchomenoi eis to phagein allēlous ekdechesthe
verses.literal: So my brothers when you come together to eat wait for one another

verses.original: εἴ τις πεινᾷ ἐν οἴκῳ ἐσθιέτω ἵνα μὴ εἰς κρίμα συνέρχησθε Τὰ δὲ λοιπὰ ὡς ἂν ἔλθω διατάξομαι
verses.transliteration: ei tis peina en oikō esthietō hina mē eis krima synerchēsthe Ta de loipa hōs an elthō diataxomai
verses.literal: If anyone is hungry he should eat at home so that when you come together it will not result in judgment And when I come I will give instructions about the remaining matters
